scope: 8 cultivos visibles; modo Huerto o jardín continúa oculto. Portadas y fotografías recientes de maíz conservadas.

entries.title: Hojas
entries.prompt: Healthy elongated cacao leaves attached to a living cacao branch, visible leaf veins, tropical orchard, whole leaf blades across the frame, no lesions or yellowing.

entries.title: Lesiones en tallos
entries.prompt: Cacao lower trunk with a clear localized elongated brown-black sunken bark lesion, cracked injured bark contrasting intact bark, entire trunk base visible in orchard, no moss mistaken for disease.

entries.title: Rama marchita
entries.prompt: A cacao side branch with brown limp dried leaves contrasted against nearby green cacao foliage, recognizable cacao pods elsewhere, clearly a wilted branch rather than a different tree.

entries.title: Manchas negras y pudrición
entries.prompt: A full attached cacao pod with a large clear dark brown-black necrotic area covering half the pod from the tip and a distinct boundary with yellow healthy rind; accurate ridges, orchard context, no hands covering lesion, intact pod in frame.

entries.title: Polvo blanco o crema
entries.prompt: An attached cacao pod with a brown necrotic patch and a fine dense WHITE TO CREAM powdery spore coating over that patch, visual reference for moniliasis-like symptoms, entire ridged pod and stem visible with green orchard background.
entries.reason: El usuario prefiere conservar la fotografía real original de la mazorca cubierta de polvo blanco.

entries.title: Base del pseudotallo dañada
entries.prompt: Banana pseudostem base with visibly dark wet deteriorated outer tissue and a small split exposing brown damaged tissue, basal region and surrounding soil clear, banana leaves establish identity, no cross-section of a healthy corm.

entries.title: Problemas en raíces
entries.prompt: A lifted banana root sample with clearly identifiable fibrous roots attached to small portion of corm, several roots dark brown decayed with reduced fine roots and contrasting intact cream roots; laid on soil beside banana pseudostem for context. Roots are main subject, not trunk lesions.

entries.title: Flores secas o caída de floración
entries.prompt: Mango flowering panicles on tree, one cluster has dry brown shriveled flowers and dead flower stalks, adjacent greener panicle, elongated mango leaves, whole panicles visible not extreme macro.

entries.title: Hojas
entries.prompt: Healthy glossy elongated mango leaf blades on living branch, whole blades, orchard setting, no disease spots.

entries.title: Raíces o tallo
entries.prompt: Healthy mango trunk base with intact bark and surface root flare in natural orchard soil, mango canopy leaves visible, no black lesions, no exposed fake root cutaway.

entries.title: Pudrición de mangos
entries.prompt: Two mango fruits on a low branch, one clearly has localized soft brown collapsed wrinkled skin and wet-looking decayed area, another intact mango behind; distinguish rotten soft fruit from flat skin spots, whole fruit visible.

entries.title: Flores secas o poca formación
entries.prompt: Avocado flowering branches with a cluster of small brown dried flowers and withered flower stalks, a few remaining green-yellow flowers, broad avocado leaves, recognizable whole panicles.

entries.title: Hojas
entries.prompt: Healthy broad oval glossy avocado leaves on branch, accurate venation and canopy, no disease spots or yellowing.

entries.title: Raíces o tallo
entries.prompt: Healthy avocado tree trunk base and root flare with intact bark, natural orchard soil and broad leaves, no canker or decayed bark.

entries.title: Manchas en aguacates
entries.prompt: Two firm avocado fruits hanging from branch with distinct small localized dry brown-black superficial spots on green pebbled rind; no large soft rotten area, intact fruit contour, orchard context. Different from a fruit entirely rotting.

entries.title: Hojas
entries.prompt: Healthy long green sugarcane leaf blades arching from a cane plant, leaf veins clear, whole blades largely visible amid recognizable cane field; no stem-only photo and no rust.

entries.title: Tallos o cogollos
entries.prompt: Healthy mature sugarcane stalks with clear nodes and internodes and intact green central whorl above, medium view of stalk group in cane field. Focus stem and growing tip, no flowers or ears, no disease.

entries.title: Toda la planta
entries.prompt: A productive vegetable bed with entire healthy tomato plants and some lettuce, recognizable stems leaves and fruits from soil to canopy, natural market garden, no ornamental flowers or house garden.

entries.title: Hojas
entries.prompt: Healthy whole tomato leaves in foreground and healthy vegetable foliage behind, accurate serrated leaflets and stems, vegetable bed not ornamental flowers, no disease.

entries.title: Dedos de banano con manchas
entries.prompt: A hand of green banana fruits attached to bunch, several distinct dark brown lesions on the SIDES OF THE PEEL, entire curved banana fingers visible with banana leaf background; no crown-end cut marks masquerading as peel lesions.

entries.title: Toda la planta
entries.prompt: Entire healthy mature cacao tree from soil to canopy, low trunk with several naturally attached red and yellow cacao pods, tropical orchard setting, generous wide framing, tree fully inside frame.

entries.title: Raíces o tallo
entries.prompt: Healthy cacao trunk base and natural surface roots with intact bark and soil, recognizable cacao pods on upper trunk and green leaves, no giant artificial underground cutaway, no symptoms.

entries.title: Mazorcas de cacao
entries.prompt: Three healthy cacao pods of red and yellow colors attached naturally to living cacao trunk, each fully visible with clear ridges, soft tropical orchard background, medium contextual view.

entries.title: Hojas
entries.prompt: A healthy broad banana leaf fully spread and arching from banana plant, central midrib and parallel veins clear, green banana plantation context, leaf main subject not sky, no lesions.

entries.title: Amarillamiento o decaimiento
entries.prompt: A branch of cacao with two elongated yellowing leaves and one limp downward leaf, nearby green leaf for context, yellow blades fully visible, cacao orchard, no giant isolated portrait leaf and no added insects.
